verdict.rationale: Maritime documents cron triggers that wake an agent on a standard five-field schedule and deliver a prompt on every fire. Agents can also set their own schedules ("send me a digest every weekday at 9"), which the platform syncs into real wake triggers. The docs further describe moving cron jobs, background workers and bots onto agents, with sleep/wake or an always-on add-on so the agent runs without a user present. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled background runs work reliably in practice (all evidence is vendor docs).
